newsitem.title: UK: Avocet offers stock option to shareholder.
newsitem.headline: Avocet offers stock option to shareholder.

text.p: Tungsten producer Avocet Mining Plc said it would offer investment firm Elliott Associates the right to subscribe to 1.06 million shares in the company at a price of 2.25 stg per share.
The company's share price was quoted at 168 pence at 1220 GMT on Wednesday in a trade turnover of 78,000 shares.

Avocet said the right would be exerciseable at any time prior to October 2, 1998 for cash or from proceeds accruing to Elliott from a separate option to sell APT (tungsten ore) to Waller Metals as part of future sale agreement.
The number of shares in agreement represents 3.4 percent in Avocet in which Elliott already controls 11.7 percent.
Avocet said on Wednesday that it had agreed on a future sale of 100,000 mtus of APT to Elliott at price of $56 per tonne (mtu) in five tranches between January and October 1998.
